title: Update Persian README for final release
description: Mirror the final English release/install/operations documentation in Persian without losing commands, links, or technical accuracy.
acceptanceCriteria: README_FA describes the same 1.2.0 artifact, runtime, install, update, rollback, backup, and verification contract as README.md
All code blocks, URLs, environment names, architecture names, and method identifiers match the English source
Persian UI direction/RTL guidance and troubleshooting are clear
No real secret values or contradictory source-build claims are introduced

steps.details: Identify missing or divergent sections and technical terms; preserve existing accurate Persian explanations.
Add/update the final release contract and operations sections with accurate Persian explanations and unchanged commands/URLs.
Run a key/command/link consistency check against README.md and inspect Markdown rendering for broken code fences.
Run the documentation check and record output.

technicalNotes: Do not machine-translate security or rollback semantics without checking the exact behavior in code/scripts.
